load_inference_model: load a PyTorch inference model from a checkpoint file with optional EMA weights and config overrides
load_tasks: load and instantiate Task objects from a checkpoint file's tasks_config
get_backbone_class_from_checkpoint: extract the backbone model class from a checkpoint's config using the registry
update_configs: recursively merge a new config dictionary into an original config handling nested dicts
tf32_context_manager: enable TF32 precision for CUDA matmul and cuDNN within a context manager block
